candidates.source_name: NBS – Registre dohliadaných subjektov (registre.nbs.sk)
candidates.why_relevant: Central NBS gateway to all supervised-entity registers (banking, capital market, payment services, intermediaries). Canonical way to enumerate every SK bank, branch of a foreign bank, payment institution and e-money institution that carries a Pillar 3 / disclosure obligation, and therefore the seed list for all downstream prudential-disclosure crawling.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Periodic HTML crawl of register index pages; check for CSV/JSON export endpoints (a sibling JSON API exists at subjekty.nbs.sk) before scraping.
candidates.discovered_via_method: local-language search on NBS supervised-entity list terms
queries_used: Národná banka Slovenska zoznam dohliadaných subjektov zverejnenia banky

candidates.source_name: NBS – Registre (dohľad nad finančným trhom) index page
candidates.why_relevant: Human-readable index that maps each register (banks, PSD2, e-money, funds, intermediaries) to its underlying system. Best single snowball page for discovering further NBS disclosure channels.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Link-extraction crawl; re-run quarterly to detect new registers.
queries_used: Národná banka Slovenska zoznam dohliadaných subjektov zverejnenia banky

candidates.source_name: NBS – Register podľa PSD2 (subjekty.nbs.sk JSON API)
candidates.why_relevant: PSD2 register of payment institutions, e-money institutions and agents. Covers the payments half of the run scope, where Pillar 3 does not apply but the equivalent compelled supervisory disclosure is register entry + licence scope. Search results indicate a machine-readable endpoint (subjekty.nbs.sk/api/psd2) returning JSON — high-value structured feed if confirmed.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Poll the JSON endpoint on a monthly cadence, diff entity list to detect new licences/withdrawals. Fall back to HTML register if the API path differs.
candidates.discovered_via_method: local-language search on payment/e-money register terms
queries_used: NBS register platobných inštitúcií inštitúcií elektronických peňazí zoznam subjekty.nbs.sk

candidates.source_name: NBS – Legislatíva: Opatrenie NBS č. 16/2014 o uverejňovaní informácií bankami a pobočkami zahraničných bánk (incl. amendment 8/2023)
candidates.why_relevant: The legal instrument that defines WHAT every Slovak bank must disclose, in which tables, and at what frequency (alongside CRR Part Eight). Reading it tells the collector exactly which structured tables to expect in each bank's 'Informácie o banke' PDF and when a template change will break parsers. Amendments (13/2015, 15/2018, 8/2023) signal schema shifts.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Watch the NBS legislation detail pages for new amending opatrenia; archive full text per version.
candidates.discovered_via_method: local-language search on the disclosure decree

candidates.source_name: NBS – Pilier III: Výkazníctvo a zverejňovanie (poisťovníctvo / Solvency II)
candidates.why_relevant: NBS opinions/positions on Pillar III reporting and disclosure. NOISY TERM WARNING: in SK, 'Pilier III' most often refers to the Solvency II insurance pillar or the third pension pillar, not banking CRR Pillar 3. Useful as a supervisory-expectation source and as a disambiguation anchor for query design.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Low-frequency page monitor.
queries_used: zverejňovanie informácií Pilier 3 banka Slovensko

candidates.source_name: Rada pre riešenie krízových situácií (Slovak Resolution Council) – official site
candidates.why_relevant: The national resolution authority for SK institutions outside the SRB's direct remit. Sets MREL for institutions incorporated in Slovakia, publishes legislation, activity pages and public-facing explanations. The separate legal channel and cadence this cell is about.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Full-site crawl of /cinnost-rady/, /legislativa/ and publications; monthly diff.
queries_used: Rada pre riešenie krízových situácií MREL zverejnenie Slovensko

candidates.source_name: Rezolučná rada – Vybrané právoplatné rozhodnutia (selected final decisions)
candidates.why_relevant: The statutory publication channel for resolution decisions affecting named SK institutions. A first entry here would be a high-signal event (institution failing or likely to fail, resolution tool applied). Search snippet suggests the page is currently empty — that emptiness is itself the signal, and the page must be monitored rather than dismissed.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Change-detection watcher (hash the listing); alert on any new item.
queries_used: Rada pre riešenie krízových situácií MREL zverejnenie Slovensko

negative_findings.description: The Slovak phrase 'Pilier 3' / '3. pilier' is heavily overloaded. It most commonly means the third pension pillar (doplnkové dôchodkové sporenie) in consumer-facing content, and secondarily the Solvency II insurance Pillar III. Banking CRR Pillar 3 results were repeatedly crowded out by pension articles (podnikajte.sk, banky.sk).
negative_findings.result_summary: Effective SK queries must avoid bare 'Pilier 3' and instead use 'opatrenie NBS č. 16/2014', 'uverejňovanie informácií bankami', 'informácie o banke k <date>', or 'informácie o činnosti banky'.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: A naive SK keyword collector on 'Pilier 3' will return mostly pension-product marketing and near-zero prudential disclosure, silently producing a false coverage gap.

negative_findings.description: No official standalone website for Garančný fond investícií (Investment Guarantee Fund) was located in this pass, despite it being an NBS-supervised statutory body under Act 566/2001 §80 with an annual-reporting obligation. Only third-party descriptions (fio.sk PDF, fininfo.sk, finstat.sk) surfaced.
negative_findings.result_summary: GFI recorded as a lower-confidence candidate pointing at secondary sources; its primary domain remains unidentified.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: GFI is the investor-protection counterpart to FOV and belongs in the same compelled-disclosure family; leaving its primary channel unmapped is a real hole in this cell.

negative_findings.description: The Rezolučná rada's 'Vybrané právoplatné rozhodnutia' page appears to contain no published decisions to date.
negative_findings.result_summary: Recorded as a source to monitor rather than as a data source, since a first entry would be a high-signal resolution event.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Distinguishing 'channel exists but is empty' from 'channel does not exist' matters — the former is a live tripwire, the latter is a gap. This is the former.

negative_findings.description: SRB MREL dashboards are aggregate across the SRB remit; no SK-country or SK-bank-level MREL breakdown was found in the dashboard publications, and no Slovakia-specific MREL disclosure list was found on srb.europa.eu.
negative_findings.result_summary: Bank-level MREL for SK institutions must be sourced from each bank's own Pillar 3 / MREL disclosure, not from the SRB dashboard.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Prevents an incorrect collection design that expects country-level MREL series from the SRB.

negative_findings.description: No dedicated disclosure landing pages were located this pass for Privatbanka, a.s., Slovenská záručná a rozvojová banka, a.s. (SZRB), UniCredit Bank Czech Republic and Slovakia (SK branch), or Wüstenrot stavebná sporiteľňa, despite all of them being subject to Opatrenie 16/2014.
negative_findings.result_summary: Absent from the candidate list; requires a targeted per-domain navigation pass rather than keyword search.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Smaller and state-owned institutions have thin SEO footprints; keyword search systematically under-covers them, biasing the source map toward the big four.

negative_findings.description: No NBS page was found publishing bank-level ICAAP/ILAAP outcomes, SREP capital requirements (P2R), or O-SII/systemic-risk buffer decisions per institution, though NBS is the designated macroprudential authority and such decisions are normally published.
negative_findings.result_summary: Searched with SK macroprudential terms ('makroprudenciálna politika', 'vankúš', 'ozdravné plány') and hit only institutional/history pages.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: P2R and buffer decisions are a compelled, structured, bank-level supervisory disclosure stream — arguably the highest-value part of this cell — and it is currently unmapped.

coverage_gaps.description: NBS macroprudential and SREP disclosure stream — O-SII designations, countercyclical capital buffer (proticyklický kapitálový vankúš) decisions, systemic risk buffer, and any published Pillar 2 requirements per institution.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run a dedicated pass over nbs.sk/financna-stabilita/ and the macroprudential policy decisions section using SK terms: 'proticyklický kapitálový vankúš', 'vankúš na krytie systémového rizika', 'O-SII', 'rozhodnutie NBS o kapitálovom vankúši'.

coverage_gaps.description: Only 8 of roughly 25-30 SK banks and foreign-bank branches have a located disclosure entry point. Small banks, state-owned SZRB, building societies and EU-passported branches are largely uncovered.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Derive the full entity list from registre.nbs.sk / the ECB LSI list, then do a per-domain navigation pass looking for the SK section names 'Povinne zverejňované informácie', 'Informácie o banke', 'Finančné ukazovatele', 'Ostatné informácie'.

coverage_gaps.description: The EBA Pillar 3 Data Hub went live 26 Jan 2026, moving EEA Pillar 3 from per-bank PDFs to centralised structured DPM data. It is unclear which SK institutions are already onboarded and whether banks will keep mirroring PDFs on their own sites.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Determine the P3DH access mechanism (API vs portal download), check SK institution coverage by LEI, and plan a dual-run period keeping PDF scraping as a bridge. Track the small/non-complex-institution discussion paper outcome.

coverage_gaps.description: Coverage is banking-heavy. The payments side of sector=both has only the NBS PSD2/e-money register, because payment and e-money institutions are outside CRR Pillar 3 and have no equivalent prudential disclosure series.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Reframe the payments prudential-disclosure equivalent as (a) NBS PSD2 register deltas, (b) safeguarding/own-funds requirements disclosed in statutory accounts filed to Register účtovných závierok, and (c) NBS enforcement decisions. Map Register účtovných závierok (registeruz.sk) as a source.

coverage_gaps.description: Register účtovných závierok (registeruz.sk), the mandatory Slovak financial-statements register, was not explored despite being the statutory filing destination for FOV, GFI, banks and payment institutions, and having a known open-data API.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Map registeruz.sk and its bulk/open-data API in a follow-up pass; it is likely the highest-yield structured backfill for the whole workstream, not just this cell.

coverage_gaps.description: English-language Pillar 3 availability is confirmed only for VÚB (parallel _EN PDF series). It is unknown whether Slovenská sporiteľňa, Tatra banka, ČSOB or others publish EN versions, or whether EN coverage exists only at group level (Erste, RBI, KBC).
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: For each SK bank, check for an EN mirror and, where absent, check the parent group's consolidated Pillar 3 (Erste Group, RBI, KBC, Intesa Sanpaolo) for a Slovak-subsidiary section.

coverage_gaps.description: No URL in this slice has been liveness-verified; several (365.bank disclosure section, the subjekty.nbs.sk PSD2 JSON endpoint, the NBS '/historia/' resolution pages) are inferred from search snippets or path patterns rather than observed directly.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Route all candidates through the deterministic verification pass; treat 403/timeout as bot-defence rather than death, and re-locate any 404 via site search before marking it dead.

brief: Slovak prudential disclosure runs on three separate legal channels with different owners and cadences: bank-published disclosures under NBS Opatrenie 16/2014 plus CRR Part Eight (quarterly and annual PDFs under SK section names 'Informácie o banke' / 'Finančné ukazovatele' / 'Ostatné informácie', with VÚB, Slovenská sporiteľňa and Tatra banka the most machine-tractable and VÚB uniquely bilingual); the resolution and guarantee bodies (Rada pre riešenie krízových situácií for national MREL, the SRB for the three ECB-significant SK banks, and Fond ochrany vkladov for deposit guarantee, the last with a clean annual-report archive and an authoritative member-bank roster); and the supervisory registers themselves at registre.nbs.sk and subjekty.nbs.sk, which supply the entity master list and, for payments, a probable JSON API. The decisive structural change is the EBA Pillar 3 Data Hub, live since January 2026, which shifts EEA Pillar 3 from scraped PDFs to centralised structured data and should be onboarded as the primary feed with per-bank scraping retained only as a bridge. Two significant holes remain: NBS's macroprudential and SREP bank-level decisions (buffers, O-SII, P2R) are unmapped, and roughly two-thirds of SK banks and branches — the small, state-owned and passported long tail — have no located disclosure entry point because keyword search does not reach them.
